narratives.body: NBC Sports reports Bradley Beal is ruled out against Sacramento due to a knee injury and remains unavailable for the Lakers game. The player's absence is confirmed by NBC Sports.
narratives.headline: Bradley Beal ruled out vs. Sacramento and Lakers due to knee injury

narratives.body: ABC30 Fresno reports the Los Angeles Clippers are indicating that Chris Paul's old No. 3 jersey will be retired for Bradley Beal.
narratives.headline: Clippers indicate Chris Paul's old No. 3 going to Bradley Beal
